turns.user: Hi! In two sentences, what is lossless compression?
turns.text: Lossless compression is a data compression method that reduces file size without losing any information. It allows the original data to be perfectly reconstructed from the compressed data.

turns.user: Give me one everyday example of it, and one of lossy compression.
turns.text: An everyday example of lossless compression is when you compress a document or image using ZIP format, allowing you to open the original file without any quality loss. An example of lossy compression is when you compress a photo using JPEG format, which reduces file size by removing some data, resulting in a slightly lower quality image.
